r1_hypothesis.hypothesis: A version-only admission observation can be made inconsistent with the actually loaded SQLite object under loader interposition, so production admission must bind version to source-id and mapped object identity rather than trusting a version string alone.

r3_counter_reality.strongest_counterhypothesis: A reported safe sqlite3_libversion() value is sufficient evidence that the process loaded the safe release.
